mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes that raise discount rates and depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in UNRATE and PAYEMS indicate an overheating labor market cooling too rapidly, increasing recession fears and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and PAYEMS does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05 in a regression).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 650,000 units), housing market strength signals overvaluation and policy tightening risks, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 650.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO above its 12-month moving average indicates robust industrial activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month average UNRATE exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession probability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% (3-month avg).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in RSAFS and GDPC1 indicate weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and GDPC1 does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05 in a regression).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), higher discount rates and reduced liquidity cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising.
